description:
Clinch C10 is a global folding bike sensation specially designed to celebrate DAHON’s 40th anniversary. Made with premium aviation-grade carbon fiber, weighing only 9.4kg, it offers a sturdy ride with 10 speeds.

Classic Strength Redefined

Featuring a diamond-shaped frame made of imported carbon fiber, this bike combines high strength with low density for exceptional performance. Safe and stylish, it easily passes EU safety tests.

Outward-folding Eiffel Handlepost

Highly rigid, simple folding and unfolding Fast and effortless, strongly and easily secured Handlepost stays put when folded, protecting from damage

Comfort on Every Ride

Features an ergonomic saddle designed for long-lasting comfort, ensuring you enjoy every mile with optimal support and cushioning.

Effortless Power Transfer

Ensures smooth and efficient power transfer, enhancing your ride's performance and making every pedal stroke count.

Precision Performance

Equipped with Shimano Tiagra for smooth shifting and TEKTRO hydraulic disc brakes for reliable stopping power, the Clinch C10’s custom lightweight wheelset enhances performance with low wind resistance and superior stiffness.

Experience True Freedom with the Clinch C10

The Clinch C10 delivers comfort and efficiency for short and long rides alike. Enjoy strong braking and flexibility in a high-tech bike that's a pleasure to ride and behold!

Revolutionizing Carbon Folding Bikes

DAHON addresses the weaknesses of single-beam carbon folding bikes by offering a high-performance design that ensures lightness, speed, and stability, all while prioritizing safety and durability.
